svg.title: Synthetic perturbational spreading map
svg.desc: What this figure shows: The heatmap is a synthetic propagation benchmark illustrating spread and decay before intervention-response distances are computed. The plotted object is generated from distributed Y_(t+tau)^V response. How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Synthetic network-response illustration. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
